adversarial_or_fault_proof: Unleased delivery, cross-owner filters, expired/revoked leases, lag, checkpoint substitution, dropped adapter frames, restart, and rebase ambiguity fail closed or emit typed outcomes.

An ephemeral-class event presented for truth admission and an admitted-class event delivered without admission both fail closed with typed outcomes; any consumer-vocabulary field required at admission is a contract defect.

Reject an un-injected build that falls back to legacy JSONL instead of refusing — proven by constructing services state without the admission capability and driving a real bridge write, not by calling the refusal directly. The un-injected proof enters through the production bridge entry point, never a test-local reconstruction of it.

Reject a duplicate key admitted N events back being appended as a new event — proven by admitting a key, walking the stream six events forward, then re-submitting: replayed=true with the ORIGINAL seq and head. Observed red on the real subject before being trusted: reverting the whole-stream walk to the head-only projection fails exactly this assertion while the consecutive-duplicate assertion still passes, which is the scope the pre-ruling bar could not see.

An ephemeral-class delivery performs ZERO substrate traversals: no admission, no append, no durability wait, and no history read to resolve its own class. Proven by COUNTING traversals on an instrumented steward, not by observing an unchanged head — an unchanged head is consistent with a read that happened.
